Descrizione Gestione del tempo HR
• Tempo pieno
• Dipartimento: Genolier Management & Services
• Carico di lavoro: 100 %
• Data di inizio: Immediatamente o con accordo Descrizione della Società Swiss Medical Network è uno dei principali gruppi ospedalieri e ospedali della Svizzera. Con 21 cliniche e ospedali, oltre a oltre 60 centri ambulatoriali in 15 cantoni, offriamo cure ospedaliere e ospedaliere di alta qualità in tutti i campi medici – in tutte e tre le regioni linguistiche del paese. La nostra infrastruttura all'avanguardia e i nostri dipendenti dedicati garantiscono assistenza medica al massimo livello. Mansioni HR-Zeitwirtschaft und Systemberatung Polypoint PEP Vuoi plasmare attivamente la HR-Zeitwirtschaft e migliorare i processi in modo sostenibile? In questa posizione responsabile, sviluppiamo continuamente il nostro sistema di gestione del tempo Polypoint PEP e contribuiamo in modo significativo ai processi HR efficienti. Come persona di contatto centrale per gli utenti nel campo della gestione della qualità, i nostri clienti interni vi consigliano con competenza. Supportano gli utenti in tutte le questioni relative al sistema di distribuzione e pianificazione e portano la loro esperienza nell'ottimizzazione continua dei nostri processi di lavoro. La vostra area di responsabilità include anche il mantenimento di icone, integratori e servizi piquet secondo i requisiti e le normative applicabili. Inoltre, sei un supporto affidabile per i nostri team HR – soprattutto nei settori della sicurezza sociale e della gestione dell'abbassamento. Essi catturano mutazioni salariali, assenti di processo e partecipano attivamente a conti mensili, trimestrali e annuali. Inoltre, controlli i servizi di abbassamento e piquetting prima di ogni libro paga e controlli continuamente i dati di pianificazione per la loro precisione. - Sviluppo e manutenzione del sistema di gestione del tempo Polypoint PEP - Controllo regolare dei dati di pianificazione e istruzioni mirate ai responsabili amministratori e manager - Supporto e consulenza di manager e utenti PEP nel campo della pianificazione, registrazione del tempo e riduzione della gestione - Supporto del sistema, controllo del rispetto del diritto del lavoro e pulizia regolare del sistema - Cura di icone, indennità e servizi di piquetting secondo i requisiti e le normative - Controllo degli assenti e dei servizi di piquet contro i salari - Gestione degli utenti PEP Login e autorizzazioni - Verifica dei dati di pianificazione per accuratezza e completezza Requisiti Il tuo profilo: - Formazione professionale completa, idealmente con formazione continua o esperienza nel personale - Gestione verificata di MS Office e interesse per la digitalizzazione delle risorse umane - conoscenza del diritto svizzero del lavoro e della sicurezza sociale di vantaggio - Forza di comunicazione, capacità di esecuzione e un funzionamento strutturato e orientato alla soluzione - iniziativa propria, talento organizzativo e alto senso di responsabilità Notevole: - Esperienza professionale pluriennale nelle risorse umane, in particolare nell'economia del tempo e/o nel libro paga - Conoscenza di Polypoint PEP o sistemi di gestione del tempo comparabili Cosa? - Spazio di progettazione: Porta la tua esperienza e forma attivamente l'ulteriore sviluppo della nostra economia del tempo - Formazione continua: Promuoviamo il vostro sviluppo professionale e personale - Ambiente di lavoro dinamico: impazienza di una variegata attività in un'azienda dall'aspetto avanzato con strutture moderne Diventa parte del nostro team e progetta la HR-Zeitwirtschaft di domani! Descrizione HR Time management
• Full time
• Department: Genolier Management & Services
• Workload: 100 %
• Start date : By immediately or by agreement Company description Swiss Medical Network is one of Switzerland's leading private hospital and hospital groups. With 21 clinics and hospitals as well as over 60 outpatient centers in 15 cantons, we offer high-quality outpatient and inpatient care in all medical fields – in all three language regions of the country. Our state-of-the-art infrastructure and our dedicated employees guarantee medical care at the highest level. Mansioni HR-Zeitwirtschaft und Systemberatung Polypoint PEP Do you want to actively shape the HR-Zeitwirtschaft and improve processes sustainably? In this responsible position, we continuously develop our Polypoint PEP time management system and contribute significantly to efficient HR processes. As a central contact person for users in the field of quality management, our internal customers advise you competently. They support users in all matters relating to the deployment and planning system and bring their expertise to the continuous optimization of our work processes. Your area of responsibility also includes the maintenance of icons, supplements and piquet services according to the applicable requirements and regulations. In addition, you are a reliable support for our HR teams – especially in the areas of social security and lowering management. They capture wage-relevant mutations, process absentees and actively participate in monthly, quarterly and annual accounts. In addition, you control lowering and piquetting services before each payroll and continuously check the planning data for their accuracy. - Development and maintenance of the Polypoint PEP time management system - Regular control of planning data and targeted instructions to the responsible directors and managers - Support and advice of managers and PEP users in the field of planning, time recording and lowering management - System support, monitoring compliance with the labour law and regular system cleaning - Care of icons, allowances and piquetting services according to requirements and regulations - Control of absentees and piquet services against wages - Management of PEP users Logins and permissions - Verification of planning data for accuracy and completeness Requisiti Your profile: - Complete vocational training, ideally with continuing training or experience in staffing - Versified handling of MS Office and interest in HR digitization - knowledge of Swiss labour and social security law of advantage - Communication strength, enforcement capacity and a structured, solution-oriented operation - Own initiative, organizational talent and a high sense of responsibility Remarkable: - Multiannual professional experience in HR, in particular in the time economy and/or payroll - Knowledge of Polypoint PEP or comparable time management systems Cosa offriamo - Design space: Bring your expertise and actively shape the further development of our time economy - Continuing education: We promote your professional and personal development - Dynamic working environment: look forward to a varied activity in a forward-looking company with modern structures Become part of our team and design the HR-Zeitwirtschaft of tomorrow! • Startdatum : Per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung Unternehmensbeschreibung Swiss Medical Network ist eine der führenden privaten Klinik- und Spitalgruppen der Schweiz. Mit 21 Kliniken und Spitälern sowie über 60 ambulanten Zentren in 15 Kantonen bieten wir eine hochwertige ambulante und stationäre Versorgung in allen medizinischen Fachrichtungen – in allen drei Sprachregionen des Landes. Unsere hochmoderne Infrastruktur und unsere engagierten Mitarbeitenden garantieren medizinische Versorgung auf höchstem Niveau. Stellenbeschreibung HR-Zeitwirtschaft und Systembetreuung Polypoint PEP Möchten Sie die HR-Zeitwirtschaft aktiv mitgestalten und Prozesse nachhaltig verbessern? In dieser verantwortungsvollen Position betreuen und entwickeln Sie unser Zeitwirtschaftssystem Polypoint PEP kontinuierlich weiter und tragen damit wesentlich zu effizienten HR-Abläufen bei. Als zentrale Ansprechperson für Anwenderinnen und Anwender im Bereich Qualitätsmanagement beraten Sie unsere internen Kundinnen und Kunden kompetent. Sie unterstützen die Nutzerinnen und Nutzer in allen Belangen rund um das Einsatz- und Planungssystem und bringen Ihre Expertise gezielt in die kontinuierliche Optimierung unserer Arbeitsprozesse ein. Zu Ihrem Aufgabenbereich gehören zudem die Pflege von Icons, Zulagen und Pikettdiensten gemäss den geltenden Vorgaben und Reglementen. Darüber hinaus sind Sie eine verlässliche Unterstützung für unsere HR-Teams – insbesondere in den Bereichen Sozialversicherungen und Absenzenmanagement. Sie erfassen lohnrelevante Mutationen, bearbeiten Abwesenheiten und wirken aktiv an Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen mit. Zudem kontrollieren Sie Absenzen und Pikettdienste vor jedem Lohnlauf und prüfen laufend die Planungsdaten auf ihre Richtigkeit. Ihre Aufgaben:
• Weiterentwicklung und Betreuung des Zeitwirtschaftssystems Polypoint PEP
• Regelmässige Kontrolle der Planungsdaten und gezielte Hinweise an die zuständigen Direktoren und Führungspersonen
• Unterstützung und Beratung von Führungspersonen und PEP-Anwendern im Bereich Planung, Zeiterfassung und Absenzenmanagement
• Systembetreuung, Überwachung der Einhaltung des Arbeitsgesetzes sowie regelmässige Systembereinigungen
• Pflege von Icons, Zulagen und Pikettdiensten gemäss Vorgaben und Reglementen
• Kontrolle von Absenzen und Pikettdiensten vor Lohnläufen
• Verwaltung von PEP Benutzer Logins und Berechtigungen
• Prüfung der Planungsdaten auf Richtigkeit und Vollständigkeit Qualifikationen Ihr Profil:
• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung, idealerweise mit Weiterbildung oder Erfahrung im Personalwesen
• Versierter Umgang mit MS Office sowie Interesse an HR-Digitalisierung

• Start date : By immediately or by agreement Company description Swiss Medical Network is one of Switzerland's leading private hospital and hospital groups. With 21 clinics and hospitals as well as over 60 outpatient centers in 15 cantons, we offer high-quality outpatient and inpatient care in all medical fields – in all three language regions of the country. Our state-of-the-art infrastructure and our dedicated employees guarantee medical care at the highest level. Description HR-Zeitwirtschaft und Systemberatung Polypoint PEP Do you want to actively shape the HR-Zeitwirtschaft and improve processes sustainably? In this responsible position, we continuously develop our Polypoint PEP time management system and contribute significantly to efficient HR processes. As a central contact person for users in the field of quality management, our internal customers advise you competently. They support users in all matters relating to the deployment and planning system and bring their expertise to the continuous optimization of our work processes. Your area of responsibility also includes the maintenance of icons, supplements and piquet services according to the applicable requirements and regulations. Your tasks: - Development and maintenance of the Polypoint PEP time management system - Regular control of planning data and targeted instructions to the responsible directors and managers - Support and advice of managers and PEP users in the field of planning, time recording and lowering management - System support, monitoring compliance with the labour law and regular system cleaning - Care of icons, allowances and piquetting services according to requirements and regulations - Control of absentees and piquet services against wages - Management of PEP users Logins and permissions - Verification of planning data for accuracy and completeness Qualifications Your profile: - Versified handling of MS Office (especially very good Excel knowledge) and interest in HR digitization - knowledge of Swiss labour and social security law of advantage - Communication strength, enforcement capacity and a structured, solution-oriented personality - Own initiative, organizational talent and a high sense of responsibility Additional information What we offer - Design space: Bring your expertise and actively shape the further development of our time economy - Continuing education: We promote your professional and personal development - Dynamic working environment: look forward to a varied activity in a forward-looking company with modern structures - Period for 1 year Become part of our team and design the HR-Zeitwirtschaft of tomorrow!
